description:
A security incident has occurred where a Junior DevOps Engineer accidentally pasted a database connection string containing a plain-text password into an internal note. Your task is to locate the ticket 'Production DB Latency' in the 'DevOps Support' mailbox and redact the password in the internal note. 

Replace the password 'ProductionPass2024!' with '[REDACTED]'. 

DO NOT delete the note or the ticket; the audit trail must be preserved. Only sanitize the specific sensitive string.
